kept.title: Nearest stop is a subway platform about 86 m away
kept.detail: The nearest stop is the Spadina Station northbound platform (Line 1), about 86 m walking by estimate. Boarding there is listed as possible and 100% of trips are flagged wheelchair accessible. The City data does not list a shelter or bench there. The walking figure is straight-line distance times 1.3, not a measured sidewalk route.

kept.title: Nearest stops with a listed shelter are on Spadina Rd at Kendal Ave
kept.detail: The nearest stop with a shelter in the City data is Spadina Rd at Kendal Ave (stop 7352), about 100 m walking. Stop 8125 at the same corner is about 112 m and also has a shelter listed. Neither has a bench listed. Both serve route 127 and list boarding as possible.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow
kept.detail: The City's winter report says sidewalk clearing begins once snow reaches 2 cm. A full clearing cycle typically takes about 12 hours. Snow under 2 cm, or snow during that window, may still be on sidewalks.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Laneways are salted, not plowed
kept.detail: The report says public laneways are salted within 24 hours after snowfall ends. They are not plowed. A walking route that uses a laneway may have snow on it.

cites.quote: salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.

kept.title: Spadina Station subway platforms have frequent service from early morning to after midnight
kept.detail: The northbound platform, about 86 m away (estimated walk), has 346 weekday departures, running from 06:12 to 26:01, which is past midnight. Weekend service is listed: 272 departures on Saturday and 224 on Sunday. Neither this platform nor the southbound one has a shelter or bench listed in City data, but that data may be incomplete.
